Hey there! Just wanted to drop you a quick line and say hello. I was out for a walk this morning and noticed the little flowers you planted in your garden are really starting to bloom now. I love seeing them pop up and the colors are so bright and pretty. They must have done well with all the rain we've had lately. I'm looking forward to seeing them get even bigger as the summer progresses. Hope you're well too. Take care!

[Your Name] 

[Optional: You could add a line about seeing them do yard work or something you noticed them doing recently to help personalize it further] 

Let me know if you want me to stop by and help with anything when you're busy. 

I enjoyed catching up briefly on the front porch a few weeks ago and hope you have a nice day. 

[Your Name
